# Events — Vars

Var definitions are derived from `module.lowdefy.yaml`. Pass these via the `vars:` block in your app's `lowdefy.yaml` entry for this module.

## Summary

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `display_key` | string | `{"_build.app":"slug"}` |  | App identifier for display objects. Events store per-app display titles keyed by app slug — this var selects which to render. Defaults to the host app's own slug; set it only to render another app's event display. Must not contain dots — dots in MongoDB field paths are interpreted as nested field navigation, breaking the $addFields extraction.  |
| `change_stamp` | object | _(see manifest)_ |  | Audit metadata template resolved at runtime. Contains runtime operators (_user, _date) that evaluate per-request.  |
| `event_types` | object | `{}` |  | Additional event type display metadata. Merged with built-in types. Keys are type strings, values have color, title, icon.  |
| `contact_page_id` | string | `` |  | Page id of the contact page that a user avatar, a timestamp and an @mention in a note link to, such as `contacts/view`. Leave empty to render them without a link. Per-call overrides via `contact_page_id` and `disable_contact_link` vars on the events-timeline component.  |
| `contact_id_query_key` | string | `_id` |  | URL query key that carries the contact id to the contact page. Leave empty to omit the id from the query string.  |
| `contact_id_path_key` | string | `` |  | Path parameter that carries the contact id, when the contact page has a `path` like `contacts/{contact_id}` (here `contact_id`). Set `contact_id_query_key` to an empty string to pass the id only in the path.  |
| `actions_collection` | string | `actions` |  | Actions collection the events timeline joins to enrich events with action cards. Defaults to `actions`; override only when your actions collection is named differently. Tenant wall: under `auth.organizations.policy: tenant` the timeline connection is walled and its joins are filtered mechanically, so a substituted collection must itself carry the `organization_id` field — without it the join fails closed (empty). Under `pinned` (the default) no field is required. Enrichment is data-driven: the join is inert when events carry no `action_ids`, so entities with no workflow actions render as an events-only timeline.  |
| `contacts_collection` | string | `user-contacts` |  | Contacts collection joined to resolve each event author's avatar (`created.user.id` → `user_id`, projecting `profile.picture`). Defaults to `user-contacts`; avatars fall back to initials when an author has no matching contact. Tenant wall: under `auth.organizations.policy: tenant` the timeline connection is walled, so a substituted collection must itself carry the `organization_id` field — without it the join fails closed (initials fallback). Under `pinned` (the default) no field is required.  |
